description: This file contains JavaScript functions for toggling visibility of setup configuration sections in the SuiteCRM installation process, along with licensing and project information comments.

methods.name: toggleSiteDefaults
methods.description: Toggles display of site default configuration sections based on checkbox state.

methods.name: toggleSession
methods.description: Toggles display of session path configuration based on checkbox.

methods.name: toggleLogDir
methods.description: Toggles display of log directory configuration based on checkbox.

methods.name: toggleGUID
methods.description: Toggles display of GUID configuration based on checkbox.
